name: Gravity Bomb, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

DESCRIPTION

This functions as per gravity bomb, except that the damage it deals each round to the target is 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, it increases the bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage dealt to the target creature by any ranged attack or ranged spell by 5 points.
